title: The waterfall at the width you picked
question: Is this the width you meant by 'not too thin' — or has it gone past a cascade into a sheet?
context_md:
You chose the wider fall on card `2fa6b0`, then chose **~8 wide and two falls** over one 12-wide when I put the width-vs-count trade to you. Neither of those was a picture of 8, so this is that picture. Same seed, same camera, same frame; the outlets sit 2 columns apart.

**What it cost, which you should see before confirming.** A wider outlet drains the lip faster than a narrow one fills it, so the *source pool* behind the fall roughly halves — measured 18 / 21 / 11 columns across three seeds where it used to be 38. The guard that checks a fall comes out of a pool rather than off a bare face had to come down from 12 columns to 10, and at a measured minimum of 11 that headroom is thin. I tried two ways to get the pool back and both are recorded as dead ends: widening the required shelf collapsed placement to *no spring at all* on two of three seeds, and widening the cut basin moved the pool by exactly nothing.

**Ignore the rock.** The stepped grey face is ordinary terrain, not part of the spring — I framed this one deliberately to keep the standing tors out after last time.

One of these is what shipped before, one is what ships now.
